response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_price_per_day FROM film WHERE rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), across_ratings AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price_per_day) AS overall_avg FROM per_rating) SELECT AVG(p.avg_price_per_day) AS avg_price_per_day, AVG(p.avg_price_per_day - a.overall_avg) AS avg_amount_above_overall FROM per_rating p CROSS JOIN across_ratings a WHERE p.avg_price_per_day > a.overall_avg
